it.polimi.ingsw.am14.model.cards.deckCards.Shaman
public class Shaman extends CharacterCard
Represents a Shaman character card within the game.

This class extends CharacterCard and introduces a mechanic involving stars. When its effect is applied, the shaman joins the player's tribe and immediately grants a specific number of stars, which serve as a resource or modifier during future shaman-related events.

    • Shaman

      public Shaman(int age, int id, int numStars)
      Constructs a new Shaman card with the specified age, unique identifier, and number of stars. This constructor is annotated with JsonCreator for Jackson JSON deserialization.
      Parameters:
      age - the historical age/era this card belongs to (passed to super)
      id - the unique identifier of the card (passed to super)
      numStars - the number of stars awarded to the player upon acquiring this card

  • Method Details

    • applyEffect

      public void applyEffect(Player player, Game context)
      Applies the shaman's specific effect.

      Registers this shaman instance within the player's tribe roster and increments the player's total star count by the value specified in numStars.

      Specified by:
      applyEffect in class Card
      Parameters:
      player - the Player who is playing or activating the card
      context - the current Game context (unused in this specific implementation)
